title: Carnarvon National Park
get_in:
Getting to Carnarvon National Park is not easy and it is more than 250 kilometres from the nearest reasonably sized town; [[Roma (Queensland)|Roma]]. From Roma, take the Carnarvon Highway north and turn onto Wyseby Road. Continue on that road, following the signs to the gorge for about 40 km. The road is fully sealed and rather well-maintained, though do be warned that many GPS and car speed readings tend to mess up once you're on Wyseby Road. Unfenced cattle also may lurk.

From the north, the nearest town is [[Rolleston]], about an hour to the north.
